description: List nearest valet operators within a 100-mile cap of a coordinate, optionally narrowed by service. Use this when a user is in a city with no listed operators and you need the closest available fallback ranked nearest-first. Empty array if nothing within 100 miles.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -90 to 90.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -180 to 180.

service.description: Optional service narrowing. One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs. Omit to list every nearby operator regardless of services offered.

name: valet_find_nearest_operators

indexed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the freshest row in the batch

operators.description: Operators within 100 miles of the input coordinate, sorted nearest-first. Empty array means nothing within 100 miles.

description_text.description: Plain-text summary; null if not on file

distance_miles.description: Distance from the input coordinate to operator HQ, rounded to 1 decimal

phone.description: Operator phone number, null if not on file

primary_city_name.description: Display name of operator HQ city

primary_state_name.description: Display name of operator HQ state

services.description: Canonical service slugs this operator offers

slug.description: Canonical kebab-case operator slug; pass to valet_get_operator for details

title: Find Nearest Operators
